card.line: Mount Zalmon is a dark, tree-covered hill near Shechem, where Abimelech and his men cut branches to burn the tower of Shechem.

moments.title: Branches cut for fire
moments.text: Abimelech and his men went up Mount Zalmon, and he cut a branch and told them to do the same. They piled the branches against the tower and burned it.
